text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arafat: Hebron has been liberated, we continue on the path to Jerusalem.
- Syria: We were on verge of comprehensive agreement with Rabin's government during Maryland talks.
- Air force F-15 crashes near southern Israel. Pilot and navigator parachute to safety.
- Arafat: Our peace is with all Israelis.
- Army identifies pilot killed in September helicopter crash.
- Treasury: Most public-sector bodies exceed wage limits.
- Turbowicz to be named Bezeq director-general today.
- Kardan, SBC to seek $50 million for venture fund.
- Arafat: "Peace with settlers"; Netanyahu satisfied with tone.
- Israel's next West Bank redeployment in Halhoul near Hebron on March 7.
- Shamrouk which holds 23 percent of Telad shares interested in selling stake.
